envelope.batchId: safe sortable identifier matching the file name

item.requestId: lowercase UUID emitted once by WPF and reused as Idempotency-Key
item.requestHash: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact fingerprint
item.bodyJson: exact UTF-8 JSON object string used as the HTTP body

hashDomains.envelopeRequestHash: requestHash authenticates the inbox protocol/backend/kind/retryJobId/bodyJson fingerprint and is validated while parsing the committed envelope
hashDomains.apiClientRequestHash: Jobs clientRequestHash is SHA-256 over the fixed method/path scope and the recursively key-sorted parsed body after removing clientRequestId, exactly as the create or retry API computes it

publication.temporaryFile: same pending directory, create-new, write-through, flush-to-disk
publication.commit: same-directory move without overwrite and with write-through

consumer.order: createdAt, then publish mtime, then file name
consumer.dispatch: fixed route with exact bodyJson and Idempotency-Key=requestId
consumer.success: matching receipt for the same requestId and jobId
consumer.failedRetrySourceDismissal: after a matching retry receipt, dismiss the original failed or canceled history row before deleting the envelope; matching replay repeats this cleanup idempotently; validation rejection, conflict, pending delivery, ambiguous transport, malformed receipt, or writer failure preserves the source history row
consumer.definitive4xx: move the envelope to needs-action after processing later valid items
consumer.delete: only after every item has a matching durable receipt

managedVideoSourceReservation.scope: video create items may reserve sourceProducerJobId or sourceManagedOutputPath; retry items resolve the referenced durable source job
managedVideoSourceReservation.wpfPublicationOverlay: after the final source validator, WPF acquires the shared Jobs writer lock, opens and identity-checks the exact source with delete sharing denied for video create, saved-Prompt video rerun, and video retry publication, records each create requestId and managed source in its UI overlay, atomically publishes pending state, and only then closes the source handle and releases the writer lock; a create overlay remains until the enqueue call returns, and a successful saved-delivery or job response first transfers protection to durable inbox or active Jobs state; every video retry source in an envelope is pinned before that envelope is published
managedVideoSourceReservation.authoritativeDeleteGuard: managed image-output DELETE holds the active Jobs-store write lock, reads the latest Jobs and idempotency state, then passively scans committed inbox state before deleting the canonical file or committing deleted status
managedVideoSourceReservation.pendingAndProcessing: a video item without a visible job or durable terminal receipt protects its named producer output or displayed managed path; unresolved video retries protect the source used by the referenced durable video job
managedVideoSourceReservation.needsAction: after a complete valid envelope scan, an item without a visible job or durable terminal receipt is the definitive 4xx no-job outcome and no longer reserves a source; items with an outcome defer to latest Jobs state
managedVideoSourceReservation.idempotencyResolution: requestId and the independently recomputed API clientRequestHash must match Jobs; envelope requestHash is separately validated by the inbox parser and is never compared with Jobs clientRequestHash; a receipt is terminal, while a visible job is accepted only with a known status and supported operation, and an active visible video source is checked directly; conflict, future, malformed, or unsupported state fails closed
managedVideoSourceReservation.retryOutcomeResolution: a visible retry outcome with matching requestId and API clientRequestHash remains authoritative after the normal matching-receipt cleanup dismisses its failed or canceled source row; when that source row still exists its operation is additionally cross-checked, while an unresolved pending or processing retry still requires the source row
managedVideoSourceReservation.malformedFutureOrOverBound: fail closed without deleting the managed output or rewriting Jobs state
managedVideoSourceReservation.passiveRead: does not create directories, claim or move envelopes, dispatch requests, wake or start a worker, retry delivery, or mutate inbox state
managedVideoSourceReservation.committedFiles: inspect safe plain .json files only; ignore uncommitted .tmp files; pending and processing filenames must match batchId, while collision-suffixed needs-action filenames retain the validated embedded batchId
managedVideoSourceReservation.publicationTransfer: video create or saved-Prompt rerun: shared Jobs writer lock -> exact source handle without delete sharing -> in-process overlay -> atomic pending publish -> source handle close -> writer lock release; video retry: shared Jobs writer lock -> validate and pin every video source in the envelope without delete sharing -> atomic pending publish -> source handles close -> writer lock release; if DELETE wins the writer lock first it completes before the publisher's final source pin, and if publication wins first DELETE must rescan the committed pending state after acquiring that lock
managedVideoSourceReservation.writerInterlock: WPF video publication and every Companion Jobs mutation use the same recoverable shared-directory-lock/v1 target at the Enhancement root's jobs.json pathname, including when SQLite is the active Jobs backend
managedVideoSourceReservation.lockOrder: both paths acquire the shared Jobs writer lock first; DELETE reads latest Jobs, passively scans inbox, verifies dependencies, deletes, and writes while holding it; publication then pins source files and publishes pending state while holding it; source handles close before writer-lock release, and wake/network/dispatch happen after release

jobsStoreIdempotency.payloadRestriction: receipt entries contain no source path, prompt, or request body
jobsStoreIdempotency.atomicity: job transition and receipt creation share one active-store transaction; legacy JSON uses its existing lock and atomic replacement
jobsStoreIdempotency.matchingReplay: return a receipt-only 2xx with the original jobId when the visible job no longer exists
jobsStoreIdempotency.conflictingReplay: return 409 when the same clientRequestId has a different clientRequestHash
jobsStoreIdempotency.capacity: when a new receipt is required at capacity, reject terminal history dismissal with 409 and retain the visible job
jobsStoreIdempotency.compatibility: legacy version-1 stores without the field remain valid
jobsStoreIdempotency.preservation: unknown root and receipt fields round-trip unchanged
jobsStoreIdempotency.integrity: malformed, duplicate, or conflicting receipt state fails closed without replacing or committing the active Jobs store

compatibility.legacyDirectPost: never used by this v1 WPF writer
compatibility.unknownOrLegacyProbe: publish locally and send no POST
compatibility.immediateNudge: allowed only for the exact ready v1 capability; after publication the authenticated bodyless queue-recovery route recovers an interrupted running row before draining the inbox and returns the matching receipt when the request id is present
compatibility.rollback: restore the prior WPF and companion together; retain published envelopes
